entries.notes: The generated declaration counter reports two plain test(...) calls, but the pinned source registers seven additional test.runIf(...) cases. All nine top-level cases are preserved, and the final HMR fuzz case is expanded into its 13 independently diagnosable mutations. The Rust suite also makes 12 load-bearing helper contracts explicit: configuration precedence, platform/canary timeout budgets, portable flow-route detection, UTF-16/UTF-8 log decoding, exact stable versus lower-bound canary log counts, quiescence before cursor windows, missing-output failure, stranded-step restoration, bounded poll diagnostics, and source conditionals. WF-RUST-091 records the shared-dev-server denial-of-service risk when a missed unlink leaves generated step registrations importing a deleted file. Final GREEN must drive the real Rust watcher, builder, generated artifacts, manifest, workflow execution, log stream, and failure-safe cleanup; returning the expected contract is insufficient.
